QuestInfo.name: The First Mission
QuestInfo.0: As a member of the Resistance, you'll have missions to undertake. #b#p2151000##k has your first mission already.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to #b#p2151003##k in #b#m310010000##k to start your first mission.
QuestInfo.2: You asked #p2151003# about your first mission.

0.0: Now that you've got equipment, I'm sure the brass is going to start giving you missions. Talk to #b#p2151003##k here in the #b#m310010000##k. She'll give you your first mission.
0.1: She's a Thief instructor, but gives missions now since she has no students. Be nice to her, and she'll give you the fun ones!

yes.0: You're in the Resistance now, but you'll still want to act like a normal person outside of headquarters. The Black Wings have Watchmen all over Edelstein, so keep a low profile whenever you leave base.
yes.1: Never speak of the Resistance outside of the base. Only discuss your missions when you return here. Understood?

no.0: Nervous about your first mission? Don't worry. #p2151003# will give you a good one.

1.0: Good to see you, #h0#. I manage missions for the whole Resistance.\r\nI think we're going to get to know each other very well.\r\n
